source.subject: test: retain C512 native NVFP4 large-M baseline

environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Jetson AGX Orin; synthetic exact-C512 Gate shape; test-only kernel

shape_and_topology.mma: sixteen inline mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16 BF16 accumulator fragments per warp
shape_and_topology.scale_reuse: one K256 16-byte scale window per output row, retained for four K64 stages
shape_and_topology.packed_weight_copy: paired adjacent lanes fill both 16-byte halves of one canonical 32-byte packed row
shape_and_topology.epilogue: 32 aligned 32-bit stores per thread instead of 64 16-bit stores

cell_history.cell: initial canonical raw-B plus A cp.async double buffer

cell_history.decision: retain because every round is positive and the cumulative native route clears 1.12x

cell_history.sass_change: 64 STG.E.U16 instructions become 32 aligned 32-bit STG.E instructions

final_result.interpretation: This is the frozen native-development baseline, not a production promotion. It is 16.97% faster than production but still needs about 4.3% additional latency reduction to clear the existing 1.22x isolated Gate gate.

rejected_or_stopped_cells.cell: U32 shared load plus shuffle register feed
redundant U32 shared broadcast without shuffle
rejected_or_stopped_cells.reason: final shared bank-conflict fraction is only 0.005406%, so the proposed instruction trade has no credible 4.3% upside
about 65024 bytes per CTA would reduce residency to one CTA per SM while long-scoreboard stall is only 1.66%
the static maximum saves 44564480 request bytes, only 4.348% of final traffic; measured traffic-to-latency response predicts less than 1% rather than the required 4.3%

decision.native_route: retain this exact test-only implementation as the next self-developed large-M optimization baseline
decision.immediate_priority: complete the admitted zero-workspace direct-dequant plus cuBLASLt Gate+Up pair screen and production integration because its measured inclusive Gate speedup is materially larger
decision.long_term_upper_bound: return to fused native work when a structural tile, decode, or data-layout change has a credible greater-than-4.3% cell-level upside; do not resume low-yield micro-tuning
